text:
natalie: Heads-up — planning a multi-region failover load test today (drain + fallback) with an apples-to-apples comparison between replay-harness and synth generator. Goal: isolate kernel selection and batching heuristics impact while keeping KV cache priming consistent.

sam: SGTM. which regions?

natalie: us-east1 + eu-west1. we'll do two phases: 1) no-drain baseline, 2) simulate region-drain by shifting 60% traffic over 90s. Both phases run replay-harness with identical seed traffic and synth with same arrival shape.

maria: important: KV cache warmup skews tail latencies. propose a 10m priming window using the real replay trace before measurement window.

kevin: can we make the kernel selection deterministic across runs? last time auto-kernel picked compact-quant1 and we saw a regression.

natalie: yes — pin kernel via --kernel-profile=stable-v2 for baseline and --kernel-profile=adaptive for experiment. that way we can measure delta.

sam: good. also add batching tweak: set continuous_batching.window_ms=25 and max_batch_size=64 for both harnesses so it's apples-to-apples.

maria: noted. for KV priming, i'll run this script:

maria: ```bash
# priming script (replay client)
./replay-client --trace recent.week.json --duration 10m --rate-scale 1.0 --target us-east1:443
```

natalie: perf-bot, can you kick off the runs after priming and post the aggregated p99/p50/cost-per-1k tokens per model variant?

perf-bot: scheduled run id run-2056789012 : baseline(stable-v2) -> experiment(adaptive). will post summaries to the thread when done :gear:

kevin: quick profiling note — enable runtime profiles with KV logging off for one of the runs to isolate kernel scheduler jitter. add `GRIND_PROFILE=kernel_scheduler` env.

sam: minor request: include synthetic run with Poisson arrival shape that matches the replay inter-arrival distribution. label them clearly.

natalie: checklist to run:
- priming (10m)
- baseline pinned kernel + batching params
- experiment adaptive kernel + same batching
- synth run with Poisson shape
- region drain simulation (60% over 90s)

maria: I'll run priming at T+10.

perf-bot: run run-2056789012 baseline finished. summary:

perf-bot: ```
baseline stable-v2 | p50: 42ms | p95: 110ms | p99: 230ms | tokens/1k $0.92
experiment adaptive | p50: 38ms | p95: 130ms | p99: 310ms | tokens/1k $0.87
```

kevin: hmm adaptive improved median but worse p99 — likely kernel churn on long sequences or KV eviction during drain. need KV eviction traces.

maria: adding KV eviction logs to next run. also let's compute tail-weighted cost metric: p99*0.6 + p50*0.4 normalized by tokens.

natalie: action items: kevin to collect KV eviction timelines, maria to run primed synth + eviction logs, sam to verify batching parity in config, I'll schedule cross-region drain run at 15:30 UTC.

sam: ack

kevin: taking it

maria: on it

natalie: thanks all — post results back here. :rocket:
